findings.claim: The existing Issue46 retained-writer test lost its owned-inspector reap assertion. The diff replaced `inspector.cleanup().unwrap()` with `cleanup_failure(...)`, which discards the cleanup result.

findings.claim: The Generic and Grok sinks are accessible through existing macOS plan fixtures, but no test asserts fact transport to them, and no supplied artifact discloses them as unexercised.
findings.disposition: Verified narrow correction at555098d; affected controls/delta mutants verified; own-session Source2 independently confirmed fixed atd930b5a, no C/H/M
findings.qualification: Coverage gap verified; existing Grok predispatch/unowned-read primary result errors mask later cleanup fact text by unchanged priority. New completed-success synthetic turn targets the reachable cleanup-selected diagnostic; reconciliation transport remains source-only.

findings.claim: The Allocation injection cases assert KillThenReaped, but scheduling can let observe() reap the child before the injected allocation read. The assertion depends on timing.
findings.disposition: Verified narrow correction at555098d; affected controls/delta mutants verified; own-session Source2 independently confirmed fixed atd930b5a, no C/H/M

findings.claim: Clock::Open, and non-target Clock::Expire checks, remove the only bound on the real child/pipe loop. Unit tests can therefore stall indefinitely on the known macOS pipe-inheritance race.
findings.disposition: Verified narrow correction at555098d; affected controls/delta mutants verified; own-session Source2 independently confirmed fixed atd930b5a, no C/H/M

findings.claim: An Interrupted read is counted as an invoked read but leaves EOF at not_observed. A WouldBlock read sets pending. This is inconsistent with the design's 'pending after a non-EOF read'.
findings.disposition: Verified narrow correction at555098d; affected controls/delta mutants verified; own-session Source2 independently confirmed fixed atd930b5a, no C/H/M
